source.verification_notes: Official Apple technical-specification page archived and matched to the 3rd-generation Late 2009 model: model A1271, 2GB/4GB configurations and finish-specific weights. Identification evidence remains in the original source section.

extraction.note: Official Apple iPod identification text retained. sections.heading: iPod shuffle (3rd generation Late 2009)
sections.source_text:
Navigation: Apple Earphones with Remote
Capacity: 2 and 4 GB
Model number and dates introduced: A1271: September 2009
iPod shuffle (3rd generation Late 2009) includes a three-position switch that toggles between off, play in order and shuffle, similar to the original iPod shuffle. This model has a headphone port that also connects to a computer's USB port. It has a clip similar to the iPod shuffle (2nd generation). iPod shuffle (3rd generation Late 2009) is smaller than the previous generations and has one status light. Previous iPod shuffle generations had two.
iPod shuffle (3rd generation Late 2009) is available in five colours.
The iPod shuffle (3rd generation Late 2009) also comes in a Special Limited Edition 4 GB model only available from the Apple Store. It comes in polished stainless steel.

sections.source_text: Shuffle Play in order Turn off

sections.heading: Environmental requirements
sections.source_text: Operating temperature: 32° to 95° F (0° to 35° C) Nonoperating temperature: -4° to 113° F (-20° to 45° C) Relative humidity: 5% to 95% noncondensing Maximum operating altitude: 10,000 feet (3000 m)

sections.heading: Capacity
sections.source_text: 2GB or 4GB flash drive 2 Holds up to 500 or 1,000 songs in 128-Kbps AAC format 3 Stores data via USB flash drive

sections.heading: Battery and power 4
sections.source_text: Built-in rechargeable lithium-polymer battery Playback time: Up to 10 hours when fully charged Charging via USB to computer system or power adapter (sold separately) 80% charged in 2 hours; fully charged in 3 hours

sections.heading: Audio
sections.source_text: Skip-free playback Frequency response: 20Hz to 20,000Hz Audio formats supported: AAC (8 to 320 Kbps), Protected AAC (from iTunes Store), HE-AAC, MP3 (8 to 320 Kbps), MP3 VBR, Audible (formats 2, 3, 4, Audible Enhanced Audio, AAX, and AAX+), Apple Lossless, AIFF, and WAV

sections.heading: Environmental Status Report
sections.source_text: iPod shuffle embodies Apple’s continuing environmental progress. It is designed with the following features to reduce environmental impact: BFR-free PVC-free Highly recyclable

sections.heading: VoiceOver Kit

sections.source_text: Earphones with Remote Frequency response: 20Hz to 20,000Hz Impedance: 32 ohms
